# SNMP PDU (`snmp_pdu`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [Application protocols](../../protocols/app.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`snmp`](snmp.md) | `version` | (any other value) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdu_type` | `enum(8)` | `160` (get_request) |   | PDU tag (0xa0 GetRequest, 0xa2 Response, 0xa4 v1 Trap, 0xa7 SNMPv2-Trap, ...). |
| `pdu_length` | `uint(8)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets (`-2`) | BER length of the PDU contents (Auto; short form, below 128). |
| `body` | `tlv` — rest of the PDU | 4 items |   | PDU contents as BER TLVs: request-id, error-status, error-index and the variable-bindings SEQUENCE. |
